description:
Problem and initialization: For a coordinate TSP, construct a rounded Euclidean distance matrix and use greedy tours with rotated starting points to obtain a starting route.

Conditional flow: In automatic mode, instances with at most 50 nodes use simulated annealing; those with 51 to 500 nodes use crossing-path dismantling followed by 2-opt; larger ones use 2-opt. The command line can override the branch. The chosen route and cost are written to an output file.

Boundary: In the annealing branch, a nonnegative time setting below 60 seconds performs zero annealing runs and leaves the final route and cost as None. The 2-opt code is independent of ALG-005; the route representation closes the tour by repeating its starting node.
